subject: S12b done: ink persists + syncs on sections/questions (card hook), LWW SQL == mergeInkItems, settings; CI 43997294386 all green
body:
# S12b done: ink persistence + cross-device sync (sections, questions; card hook for S10)

## Commits on claude/naadi-shared
5e41abc (API: migration 0009, ink API, parity fixtures) · c8978a1 (engine applyRemote + anchors) · 554ab3e (web persistence, mounts, settings) · 952cd73 (e2e, InkSurface host fix, CI screens/12b) · 260e521 (offline/cached-copy: no network; pagehide abort) · 21fefc4 (data-ink-idle) · b7f258a (keepalive loads) · 4b23e2b (hasOpaqueBlocks) · 3fcf24e (live block anchors) · dc6b1eb / ac2bdc5 (e2e detector).

## CI
Run 43997294386 on ac2bdc5 — all 5 jobs green (lint·typecheck·unit·drift·models·build, db integration, e2e webkit/chromium/firefox × 6 viewports): https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43997294386

## Tests
- pytest unit 602 passed; db 334 passed / 1 skipped on a fresh stack (incl. 84 ink db tests + 59 model/fixture parity).
- vitest: web 254, ink 66, shared 125, ui 27. Lint (biome, ruff), tsc, mypy, gen:contracts, gen:requirements: no drift.
- Local smoke (REVIEW_CHECKLIST set + ink-sync, --retries=0, 2×): ink-sync and learn green in both runs; the only reds were other segments' known WebKit flakes (S08 Lab sheet axe, since fixed upstream; S10 /api/cards/stats cut-off fetch — reported to seg10).

## What's built (brief items)
- 0009: ink_items (PK layer_id,item_id; seq cursor; content_rev; written_at; item/updatedAt/deleted check), ink_layers rev/item_count/content_hash/purged_rev, strokes dropped; select-only for clients on both (RLS forced, 4 _own policies, grants revoked); RLS coverage, live_check (new select-only check + mutations), schema.sql.
- API naadi_api/ink: pydantic mirror of zod InkItem (strict; zod int/number/length semantics) checked against shared fixtures + ink.schema.json; GET /api/ink/{type}/{id}?since= (full load w/o tombstones, incremental with them, reset below purged_rev or future cursor, outdated count); POST .../changes: per-item validation (invalid/stale/duplicate), single LWW upsert in SQL (updatedAt, tombstone on tie, stored row on full tie), +5 min clamp, 500 items/2 MB/20k live (409 ink_item_limit, rolled back), remote = seq>base_rev minus own + server copy of stale. Surfaces: section/question/flashcard (RLS-visible), exam_scratch/notebook_page/pdf_page (own); anything else 404. Daily 90-day tombstone purge (advisory lock). Bodies never logged (tested). settings.ink validated in PATCH /api/me.
- Golden merge vectors: packages/shared/fixtures/ink/merge-vectors.json — mergeInkItems (vitest, both orders) == SQL upsert (pytest, both orders).
- Engine: InkDocument/InkEngine.applyRemote (no undo step, no diff, never resurrects local deletes, undo restamp still wins), anchors.ts (stampAnchor on commit, resolveAnchor on load/remote/undo/redo, reanchor()), InkSurface `anchors` prop.
- Web ink/persist: InkSync (pending map via recordInkDiff, Dexie 4.4.7 inkPending + inkLayers snapshot written before any request; flush 800 ms idle / 50 items / hidden keepalive / pagehide sync keepalive POST <64 KB; backoff; merge in mergeInkItems order), useInkLayer (TanStack Query refetch on mount/focus/visible/reconnect/30 s; remote via applyRemote), InkSaveStatus (icon+word: Saved / Saving… / Saved on this device · will sync / Couldn't save · Retry), SectionInk (Reader; ink toolbar replaces the page bar while writing = one lime; outdated notice; hasOpaqueBlocks), question view (stem+options only), card hook for S10 (useInkLayer('flashcard', id)), Settings → Pencil & ink (/settings/ink). ContentRenderer data-block-pm from @naadi/shared/content/positions (checked against ProseMirror on all 259 seeded bodies); anchors measured live.
- e2e ink-sync.spec: reload persists; second device sees it within one refetch; delete vs later edit → LWW on both; offline (route abort) → reload → reconnect → synced; 1180→390 px stays beside its paragraph within 1 px; error+Retry, outdated notice, settings, question ink, prod (strict CSP) server with zero console errors.

## Checklist
- Copy: 25 ui_copy keys (config, REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS, regenerated defaults); persist dir has its own no-hard-coded-copy test. Server responses structured (error code ink_item_limit, reject reasons). One lime per view (reader: toolbar replaces page bar). Status = icon + word. Phone 390/412 checked (toolbar scrolls sideways).
- Security: clients cannot write ink tables (revoked + tested); explanation never inked; answers untouched. Prod-CSP e2e passes with zero console errors. No LLM/web calls.
- Tests waits: data-ink-idle marker; learn.spec quiet() waits for it.
- Screenshots: test-results/screens/12b/*.png (reader off/on/saved/local/error/outdated/reflow-390, question saved, settings + changed) for webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440; full matrix in the CI e2e-* artifacts (12b/).

## Decisions
- Server stores the item JSON as sent (validated), not a re-serialisation (1 stays 1). Tombstones compacted to one point (never rendered).
- content_rev per item (md5 of section body / stem+options / card front) → outdated count; ink never dropped.
- Purge runs in-process (daily, advisory lock), not an Aegra cron.
- Reader toolbar takes the page bar's place while ink is on (one lime action).
- Ink GETs are keepalive (WebKit reports navigation-cancelled fetches as page errors); fetch skipped when offline or the reader shows its device copy.
- Engine full tie keeps the local copy (display may differ only by anchor placement); server keeps stored row; clients adopt server versions via applyServer.
- Fixed in S12a code (agreed with seg12-ink): InkSurface host pointer-events:none (it blocked clicks on content while ink was off).
